bonus_text.en:
Rare Glyph 
Diminish
Radius Size: 3 
Grants +25.0% bonus to all Rare nodes within range.
Additional Bonus: 
You take 15% reduced Physical damage from Vulnerable enemies.
Required (purchased in range): +40 Strength
Legendary Bonus: 
Increase damage to Vulnerable targets by 0.5% [x] . 
Required: Legendary Upgrade (unlocks at Level 50)
